prerequisites.title: SHAHAB-013 Release & Artifact Integrity
prerequisites.detail: SHAHAB-013 entry gate evaluated as PARTIALLY_VERIFIED (release=SHAHAB-R2.0.0-RELEASE-CANDIDATE).
limitations: External cryptographic signing infrastructure not provisioned (automatic production rollout disabled).

prerequisites.title: SHAHAB-014 Operational Observability & Safe Lifecycle
prerequisites.detail: Local-first operational observer, PII scrubber, consent records, feedback admission gate, and 14-state update lifecycle present and persisted.
limitations: External remote telemetry collector endpoint is intentionally disabled by default (local-first privacy).
Automatic rollout remains disabled pending SHAHAB-013 cryptographic signing.

prerequisites.title: Unified Local/Cloud Execution Architecture
prerequisites.detail: Shared 19-stage SHAHABEngine contract with LOCAL, CLOUD, and AUTO modes and explicit no-silent-fallback enforcement.
limitations: Browser WASM execution and Native sherpa-onnx C++ binary are not verified in this Linux CPU sandbox.

prerequisites.title: Audio-Processing Job Lifecycle
prerequisites.detail: Existing OperationLifecycleManager handles generic operation tracking; SHAHAB-015 formalizes the crash-safe 14-state SHAHAB ASR job state machine with atomic persistence and idempotency keys.
limitations: Prior to SHAHAB-015, SHAHAB ASR jobs did not persist stage-level crash-recovery checkpoints.

prerequisites.title: Existing Persistence & Crash Recovery Mechanisms
prerequisites.detail: Existing Avapardaz project checkpointing (CrashRecoveryAndSessionLock) and SHAHAB atomic JSON/JSONL store verified; extended for SHAHAB ASR stage checkpoints and disaster recovery.
limitations: Filesystem rename durability varies across OS/filesystems; parent-directory fsync is best-effort on non-POSIX hosts.

prerequisites.title: Existing Cancellation & Interruption Behavior
prerequisites.detail: AbortSignal propagation exists across SHAHABEngine and Zipformer decoding stages; SHAHAB-015 enforces non-destructive cancellation preserving committed user transcripts.
limitations: In-flight native/WASM ONNX kernel invocations cannot be preempted mid-op; cancellation takes effect at chunk/stage boundaries.

prerequisites.title: Existing Error Handling & Retry Policies
prerequisites.detail: Avapardaz reliability error classifier and SHAHAB-010 21-code taxonomy present; SHAHAB-015 extends them with the complete 33-code centralized resilience taxonomy and bounded idempotency-aware retry controller.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Audio Ingestion
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: WAV file path, raw buffer, or chunked PCM stream + request metadata
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Immutable audio reference + SHA-256 content hash + byte size
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: Source audio file (read-only; never mutated by SHAHAB)
pipelineBoundaries.temporaryState: In-memory read buffer during hash computation
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Re-read immutable source audio reference; never mutate source recording.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Clear error explaining source file could not be read; source audio remains untouched.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Audio Validation
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: Raw audio bytes / RIFF WAV header
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Validated audio descriptor (sampleRate, channels, durationSec, pcmSha256)
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Fail fast without retrying invalid media; instruct user to provide valid PCM WAV.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Immediate non-retried explanation identifying unsupported format or corrupted header.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Preprocessing (Mono 16kHz Normalization & Chunking)
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Float32 mono 16kHz PCM normalized to [-1, 1] + overlap chunk windows
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: None required (deterministic recomputation from immutable source)
pipelineBoundaries.temporaryState: Float32Array PCM buffers bounded by SHAHABMemoryGovernor
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Release temporary buffers and re-run with smaller chunk window under memory pressure.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Reports preprocessing failure or reduced-concurrency memory-safe mode.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Model & Tokenizer Initialization
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Verified ONNX Runtime sessions (encoder, decoder, joiner) + BPE token map
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: Verified read-only model artifacts under models/ + active release manifest
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Serialize concurrent model loads (max 1); verify SHA-256 before load; if corrupted stop and request verified reacquisition or rollback to last known-good release.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Blocks inference safely; identifies integrity mismatch or runtime unavailability without crashing workspace.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Feature Extraction (80-dim Kaldi Log-Mel FBANK)
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: Optional SHA-256 verified feature checkpoint on disk or SHAHABAudioFeatureCache
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Evict feature cache on memory pressure; recompute deterministically from immutable source audio if checkpoint missing/corrupted.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Transparently bypasses cache with degraded-mode operational event if cache integrity is uncertain.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Zipformer Encoder Execution
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: 80-dim FBANK tensor + verified encoder ONNX session
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Encoder acoustic representations [1, T_out, D] cached in SHAHABEncoderOutputCache
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: Optional POST_ENCODER_EXECUTION checkpoint with model/tokenizer/audio/preprocessing hashes
pipelineBoundaries.temporaryState: ONNX intermediate tensors & encoder cache entry
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Checkpoint encoder output per completed chunk; on worker crash, verify checkpoint digest & model compatibility before skipping already-encoded chunks.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Marks job RECOVERY_PENDING if prior chunks were committed, or FAILED_RECOVERABLE with clear resume option.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Transducer Decoder & Joiner Execution (Greedy / Adaptive Beam)
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: Cached encoder output + decoder/joiner sessions + decode policy
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Raw acoustic BPE token sequence, frame indices, log-probabilities
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Reuse verified cached encoder output without re-running encoder; never silently downgrade decode policy without explicit degraded-mode record.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Preserves completed chunk outputs with explicit PARTIAL designation; never labels incomplete output as COMPLETED.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Persian Context Memory & False-Insertion Guard
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: Raw acoustic output + 4-scope Persian context memory + tokens.txt
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Context-assisted output + evidence ledger records (raw acoustic preserved verbatim)
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Graceful degradation: disable optional contextual biasing, record CONTEXTUAL_BIASING_DISABLED event, and preserve raw acoustic transcript.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Displays explicit degraded-mode notice that contextual vocabulary assistance was bypassed while raw acoustic output succeeded.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Frame-to-Word Alignment & Timestamp Generation
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: Decoded BPE token frame indices + chunk offsets + sample rate
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Word-level start/end timestamps (seconds & flicks) + overlap deduplication
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: None (derived deterministically from decoded frame indices)
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Recompute alignment from verified chunk token frames; fail cleanly if monotonic timestamp invariants are violated.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Reports timestamp alignment failure instead of emitting corrupted timeline spans.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Four-Layer Transcript Assembly & P0-009 Normalization
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: Raw acoustic tokens, context-assisted tokens, P0-009 normalization rules
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Transcript preserving rawAcoustic, contextAssisted, normalized, and authorizedFinal provenance
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: Durable transcript artifact after B12 commit
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Reassemble deterministically from verified chunk checkpoints; never replace an existing authorizedFinal transcript with partial recovery.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Flags partial transcript clearly; requires explicit commit before marking job COMPLETED.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Avapardaz Editing Timeline Bridge
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: PersianWordToken[] synchronized to Avapardaz timeline without overwriting user-authorized edits
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Deduplicate completion events by jobId + idempotencyKey; protect committed user edits from overwrite.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Prevents duplicate timeline insertion and alerts user if session lock or project state is inconsistent.

pipelineBoundaries.name: Atomic Persistence & Operational Export
pipelineBoundaries.inputs: Finalized transcript / job state / manifest payload
pipelineBoundaries.outputs: Atomically committed JSON/JSONL file with verified SHA-256 integrity
pipelineBoundaries.persistentState: Canonical docs/shahab/* and workspace project storage
pipelineBoundaries.recoveryStrategy: Write temp -> flush/fsync -> parse & hash verify -> atomic rename; previous committed file remains untouched on any error.
pipelineBoundaries.userVisibleFailureBehavior: Job stays FAILED_RECOVERABLE (never COMPLETED) on persistence failure; existing committed data stays intact.

degradedModesCatalog.activationCondition: Contextual vocabulary subsystem or P0-010/P0-012 hook throws or fails compatibility check.
degradedModesCatalog.knownImpact: Domain terminology biasing skipped; raw acoustic recognition preserved verbatim.
degradedModesCatalog.recoveryCondition: Contextual memory & tokens.txt verified healthy on next job.
degradedModesCatalog.userVisibleStatus: Degraded: Contextual vocabulary disabled (raw acoustic output active).

degradedModesCatalog.activationCondition: Memory pressure or cache integrity mismatch detected.
degradedModesCatalog.knownImpact: Higher latency (features/encoder recomputed); acoustic output identical.
degradedModesCatalog.recoveryCondition: Process RSS returns below soft threshold and cache reinitializes cleanly.
degradedModesCatalog.userVisibleStatus: Degraded: Acoustic cache bypassed for safety.

degradedModesCatalog.activationCondition: Process memory pressure or CPU exhaustion.
degradedModesCatalog.knownImpact: New jobs queued sequentially (max 1 active inference).
degradedModesCatalog.recoveryCondition: Active RSS and queue pressure normalize.
degradedModesCatalog.userVisibleStatus: Degraded: Concurrency reduced to 1 active job.

degradedModesCatalog.activationCondition: Measured available disk space falls below manifest requirement + safety margin.
degradedModesCatalog.knownImpact: New processing jobs paused; existing committed transcripts remain readable.
degradedModesCatalog.recoveryCondition: Measured available disk space exceeds threshold.
degradedModesCatalog.userVisibleStatus: Degraded: New jobs paused due to low disk space.

degradedModesCatalog.activationCondition: Inference interrupted or cancelled after >= 1 chunk committed durably.
degradedModesCatalog.knownImpact: Only completed chunks available; explicitly tagged PARTIAL (never COMPLETED).
degradedModesCatalog.recoveryCondition: Full job recovery completes remaining chunks and commits atomically.

backupScopePolicy.rationale: Critical user recordings/edits; NEVER uploaded externally without explicit authorization.
Irreplaceable human-reviewed transcripts; protected from partial-recovery overwrite.
Small structured JSON metadata essential for timeline and provenance restoration.
Tiny SHA-256 lineage manifests enabling verified reacquisition of exact model revisions.
Excluded (~115.77 MB); securely reacquirable by pinned 40-char commit SHA + SHA-256 manifest.
Small local runtime & consent preference files.
Sanitized local operational ledger; external sharing strictly opt-in.
Ephemeral FFT/encoder buffers and .tmp files are disposable and excluded.

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Transition to FAILED_RECOVERABLE; forbid invalid jump to COMPLETED

scenarios.faultInjected: Crash/restart during encoder execution on chunk 1 + duplicate completion event
scenarios.initialState: PROCESSING with verified chunk-0 POST_ENCODER_EXECUTION checkpoint
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Verify checkpoint integrity, resume chunk 1, commit full transcript, reject duplicate COMPLETED

scenarios.faultInjected: Decoder/persistence interruption attempting partial overwrite + user cancellation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject partial recovery overwrite; cancellation preserves committed user transcript

scenarios.faultInjected: Simulated ENOSPC disk full during atomic write + low-space preflight
scenarios.initialState: Previously committed transcript file with verified SHA-256
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Abort write without retry, pause new jobs, preserve prior committed file bit-for-bit

scenarios.faultInjected: Mid-write EIO interruption after writing 1/3 of temp file
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject partial write, clean temp file, keep commitSeq=42 intact

scenarios.faultInjected: Post-write tampering of checkpoint payload JSON
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detect SHA-256 mismatch and reject recovery with CHECKPOINT_CORRUPTED

scenarios.faultInjected: Memory pressure cache eviction + 3 simultaneous model initialization calls
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Serialize concurrent model loads (peak=1), evict cache safely, emit degraded event

scenarios.faultInjected: Unauthorized LOCAL->CLOUD fallback + Cloud REQUEST_TIMEOUT + duplicate Cloud delivery
scenarios.initialState: Isolated Local/Cloud guard and bounded Cloud retry policy
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Block silent LOCAL->CLOUD upload, recover Cloud timeout within retry limit, suppress duplicate Cloud request

scenarios.faultInjected: Post-manifest artifact tamper + incompatible tokenizer + mismatched recording + unsupported schema version 99.0.0
scenarios.initialState: Verified model manifest and valid checkpoint
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Block tampered artifact and reject all 3 incompatible checkpoints with exact failure codes

scenarios.faultInjected: Interrupted/corrupted artifact extraction during staged installation + simulated activation crash rollback
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject interrupted candidate, keep last known-good release active and intact, complete lifecycle rollback

scenarios.initialState: Normal recognition with contextual biasing enabled
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Activate CONTEXTUAL_BIASING_DISABLED (marked non-equivalent), preserve raw acoustic output
